summary: Backend testing for admin bulk-delete and dedupe endpoints. 7/7 tests passed (100%). Auth guards, empty/invalid ids handling, selective bulk-delete without side-effect on other products, dedupe by (series+issue+category), dedupe fallback by (title+category), oldest-kept-by-created_at rule, and catalog count invariance (initial count == final count) all validated.

minor.issue: Hard cap of 500 in to_list(500); if catalog grows beyond, initial/final count invariant check becomes unreliable and dedupe scanning is also limited to 5000 products. Not a bug today but a scalability concern.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:360 dedupe uses to_list(5000) — if catalog exceeds 5000 items, duplicates beyond that won't be considered.
server.py:199 GET /api/products limited to 500 items — admin listing should probably use a higher limit or pagination.
seed_data_creation: All test products created with TESTQA_ prefix (title and/or series). All TESTQA_ products deleted during test cleanup; module-scoped autouse fixture asserts final GET /api/products count equals initial count.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk-delete and dedupe endpoints fully functional. Tests are idempotent and safe: they only touch TESTQA_-prefixed items and enforce catalog-count invariance in teardown. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_dedupe.py for regression.
